notes: v0.3.86: SEAMLESS REJOIN. When your partner drops (app crash, PC restart, network blip), your session now waits up to 10 minutes with a live countdown while they come back — a one-tap 'Rejoin last session' button reconnects them and audio snaps back automatically. Network blips where both sides drop self-heal with zero clicks. The audio hot path is untouched (a single atomic read per packet). Also: relay-mode sessions finally show the lost-connection banner, and rejoin attempts that can't re-establish a direct connection give a clear error instead of hanging.
